location_description:
Graham is a city in north-central Texas. It is the county seat and largest city of Young County.


== History ==
The site was first settled in 1871 by brothers Gustavus A. and Edwin S. Graham, primary shareholders in the Texas Emigration and Land Company of Louisville, Kentucky.
